calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS open_ended, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(join_date), max(join_date), count(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_to >= current_date AND valid_from <= current_date) AS valid_today
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current) AS current_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current) AS current_ids,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold') AS gold_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_gold,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member g WHERE g.is_current AND g.tier='Gold' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member o WHERE o.member_id=g.member_id AND o.valid_from>g.valid_from)) AS gold_with_later_version,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from>valid_to) AS bad_ranges,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
 (SELECT max(valid_from) FROM stg_member_updates) AS stg_max,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates) AS stg_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates s JOIN dim_member d USING (member_key)) AS stg_in_dim

calls.statement:
SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS gold_active_52w
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_member fm ON fm.member_key = f.member_key
JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id = fm.member_id AND m.is_current AND m.tier = 'Gold'
WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
